Cupping Therapy

Cupping does something
most hands can't —
it lifts.

Most bodywork applies pressure down into the tissue. Cupping works the opposite way — it uses suction to lift the tissue, creating space and drawing circulation into areas that have been compressed or restricted.

For myofascial work and chronic tension, that difference matters. Cupping reaches adhesions and restrictions that compression techniques simply can't access.

"My favorite is the cupping — it really releases the sticky myofascial connective tissue and promotes healing. I have felt mass improvement after this procedure."

— Michelle Mitchell

Cupping is typically incorporated within a broader integrative session rather than booked as a standalone service. Book a customized session and communicate your interest in cupping — Nikki will incorporate it where appropriate.
